prompts: Use case: sketch-to-render. Fill this strict 2:1 architectural projection guide with one single-storey Ming Jiangnan grocery shop. Preserve exact ground silhouette from grey bottom quadrilateral: L168,550; F868,900; R1368,650; B668,300. The ground dimensions MUST remain 7 by5, both slopes+0.500/-0.500. Do not move the corners, reframe, change camera or zoom. The guide is a geometry lock, render material over it. The long lower-left facade is an open dark-brown timber counter with a few plain pottery jars, burlap grain bags, plain folded fabric under a short undyed cloth awning. White plaster side gable, charcoal grey clay tiled simple gable roof, straight simple lattice side window, restrained roof eave upturn. Fine realistic matte weathered wood and individual clay tiles, historical game sprite density, muted colors. All architecture and steps contained within thin grey stone rectangular base; no thick plinth, no scenery. No visible guide lines. Upper-left light, tiny contact shadow to lower-right. True transparent RGBA: background completely absent, alpha0 outside exact cutout; opaque surfaces. No beige glow, halo, vignette, mist, text, signage, symbols, people, watermark, checkerboards or white matte. One isolated shop, full eaves and base inside frame.

No thick plinth.
